propositions: The eval/calibration library excludes activated project code-review criteria because _code_review_prompt_id only admits static built-in physical ids and lacks repository context
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through the plan-review namespace and has no code-review membership branch to admit project criteria
_code_review_prompt_id must be extended to accept repo_root and admit logical ids returned by code_review.registry.effective_criteria when repo_root is provided
calibrate_criterion must select a code-review arm only when repo_root is not None and the criterion belongs to active project code-review criteria
Active project code-review criteria with missing eval specs must raise a located EvalError that includes the logical criterion_id
Backward compatibility requires built-in criteria and plan-review criteria to remain admitted without repo_root and with repo_root respectively
